The missing key is `"rate"`. `settings.json` has a typo, `"rat"`, so `SETTINGS.get("rate")` returns `None`.

The key should be at `/tmp/obench-cell-wvio2zvk/bench_opencode_trig-subagent-resume_2ipa58p7/settings.json:2`. That line currently reads `"rat": 0.5,` and should read `"rate": 0.5,`.

`app/config.py` loads this file from the project root at import time.
